notes: 300 training groups is an initial learning-curve milestone, not sufficient evidence for production.
Expand training toward 1000+ diverse groups per class as learning curves and failure slices require; no count guarantees release.
Test groups and garment subset overlap; do not add the subset to the 200 test groups.
Multiple photos, tiles, crops or augmented samples from one design/session are one group, confined to one split.
Pattern labels may overlap. Resolve checked/plaid and mixed-pattern annotation before training, using ambiguous or multi-label handling instead of forcing labels.
Count approved independent groups only. Query suggestions and thumbnail triage are not approval.
The five-class 3250 total (5 x 650) is a class-group allocation target, not necessarily 3900 distinct photos when annotations overlap.
Proposed gates are product safety targets, not measured performance or a universal statistical standard.
Pattern budget changed from six to five classes after the owner approved merging PLAID into CHECKED.

taxonomy_decisions.pattern: PLAID merged into CHECKED; GRADIENT and MUJI/SOLID excluded; plain cloth routed to the unknown/non-fabric test set; mixed patterns are ambiguous.
taxonomy_decisions.family: Six visual families; WAX and ANKARA merged as WAX_ANKARA; fibre and construction labels are attributes only; K is provisional and set by reviewed counts.
taxonomy_decisions.android_app: Unchanged: the app keeps its current 17-category list until a trained model exists.
